name: 70121 · Jefferson, LA
findings: ZIP 70121 (Jefferson) has 50 nonprofit organizations. 21 of them (42%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 19 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (25% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 70121 (Jefferson) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 70121 (Jefferson) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.3 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 19 organizations here; 24% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are groups to join so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
